title: x402 Domain Discovery Manifest
description: Authoritative RFC 8615 well-known domain discovery manifest for x402 payment-enabled origins (/.well-known/x402).

x402Version.description: The x402 protocol specification version. Must be 2.

kind.description: The operational role of this host in the x402 topology.

facilitator.description: Optional URI pointing to an external authoritative facilitator service.

keys.description: Host-level cryptographic public keys for manifest and challenge signature verification.

extensions.description: Optional container for experimental, forward-compatible, or vendor-specific extension payloads without violating root schema determinism.

resources.description: Payment-enabled endpoints and services served by this host.

openapi.description: Optional pointer to developer documentation and OpenAPI descriptions. Strictly informational; payment discovery is resolved directly via resources.

anyOf.description: Resource servers declare the resources array.
Hosts acting as standalone or hybrid facilitators may omit the resources array.
Hosts declaring OpenAPI documentation pointers during the migration phase.

atomicAmount.description: Non-negative integer string representing asset quantity in its smallest atomic denomination (e.g. satoshis, base units).

kid.description: Key identifier, matching DNS TXT ground truth records.

publicKey.description: Public key encoded in hex or base64.

scheme.description: The x402 payment and settlement scheme.

asset.description: Settlement asset contract address, currency code, or native symbol.

recipient.description: Authoritative payee address or account identifier.

path.description: URL path or URI template of the monetized resource.

description.description: Human and agent readable summary of the resource.

methods.description: HTTP methods applicable to this payment requirement. Defaults to all methods if omitted.

accepts.description: Supported payment options for this endpoint.
